name: Task_4
description: Prepare the force constants for bulk palladium. Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 checkpoint, a one-atom primitive FCC cell with conventional lattice parameter 3.89 Å, and a 5 x 5 x 5 supercell. Keep the geometry fixed. Choose a suitable force-constant method and document its numerical settings and symmetry treatment. Save the evaluated structures with their energies and complete force arrays, the displacement mapping or analytical derivative data, and the force constants. Report basic symmetry and acoustic checks, and record the model identity.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
